people.name: Plutarco Elías Calles
people.nameZh: 普魯塔科·埃利亞斯·卡列斯

body.zh-Hant: 卡列斯1877年9月25日生，是普魯塔科·埃利亞斯的私生子。他四歲喪母，由繼父胡安·B·卡列斯撫養，並沿用其姓氏。他在埃莫西約受教育後當過學校教師，1899年因第一任妻子去世遷往瓜伊馬斯港，先後擔任學校督學與報紙編輯，1906年遷往弗龍特拉斯管理父親的莊園，1910年再回瓜伊馬斯經營旅館。
body.en: Calles was born on 25 September 1877, the illegitimate son of Plutarco Elías. His mother died when he was four, and he was raised by his stepfather, Juan B. Calles, from whom he took his second family name. After being educated in Hermosillo he became a schoolteacher, moved to Guaymas after his first wife died in 1899, worked there as a school inspector and newspaper editor, moved to Fronteras in 1906 to manage his father's hacienda, and returned to Guaymas in 1910 to manage a hotel.

heading.zh-Hant: 革命年代與索諾拉州長

body.zh-Hant: 1911年卡列斯競選州議員落選，隨後在邊境小鎮阿瓜普列塔與人合開雜貨店。1912年他對抗奧羅斯科叛軍，並出任阿瓜普列塔警察局長。1915至1919年他擔任索諾拉州長兼軍事司令。1919年5月他獲卡蘭薩總統任命為工商勞工部長，1920年2月為投入歐布雷貢的競選而辭職。
body.en: In 1911 Calles ran unsuccessfully for the state legislature and then opened a general store, in partnership, in the border town of Agua Prieta. In 1912 he fought the Orozquista uprising and served as police commissioner of Agua Prieta. From 1915 to 1919 he was governor and military commander of Sonora. In May 1919 President Carranza named him secretary of industry, commerce and labor, and in February 1920 he resigned the post to campaign for Obregón.

secretario de Industria, Comercio y Trabajo por el presidente Carranza

body.zh-Hant: 1920年4月，卡列斯與歐布雷貢、德拉韋爾塔宣布阿瓜普列塔計畫，反對卡蘭薩政府。新政府成立後，他自1920年5月4日至11月30日擔任戰爭與海軍部長，其後在歐布雷貢總統任內出任內政部長，據百科條目為1920至1923年。
body.en: In April 1920 Calles, Obregón and De la Huerta proclaimed the Plan of Agua Prieta against the Carranza government. After its triumph he served as secretary of war and navy from 4 May to 30 November 1920, and then as interior secretary under President Obregón, which the encyclopedia dates to 1920–1923.

citations.quote: en abril de 1920 el grupo sonorense integrado por Obregón, Calles y De la Huerta
proclamó el Plan de Agua Prieta que desconocía al gobierno carrancista
Secretario de Guerra y Marina del 4 de mayo al 30 de noviembre de 1920
fue secretario de Gobernación en el gabinete del presidente Obregón
served as Obregón's interior secretary (1920–1923)

body.zh-Hant: 卡列斯在選舉中擊敗對手安赫爾·弗洛雷斯，1924至1928年出任墨西哥總統，任期至1928年11月30日。任內他重整國家財政，促成國家銀行委員會與墨西哥銀行的設立，並推行激進的反教權政策。
body.en: Calles won the election against his opponent Ángel Flores and held the presidency of Mexico from 1924 to 1928, until 30 November 1928. In office he reorganized the national finances, which culminated in the founding of the National Banking Commission and the Bank of Mexico, and pressed a radical anticlerical policy.

citations.quote: Calles obtuvo el triunfo en las elecciones al vencer a su oponente Ángel Flores
Calles ocupó la Presidencia de la República de 1924 a 1928
desempeñó hasta el 30 de noviembre de 1928
Reorganizó las finanzas nacionales
la fundación de la Comisión Nacional Bancaria y el Banco de México
Calles pressed his radical anticlericalism

body.zh-Hant: 1929年卡列斯促成國民革命黨成立，並於3月3日再任戰爭與海軍部長，5月16日卸任。1931年10月16日至1932年7月31日他又回任此職，1933年在羅德里格斯內閣任財政部長。1929至1934年間，他以「革命最高領袖」之名對全國政治保有決定性影響力。
body.en: In 1929 Calles promoted the founding of the National Revolutionary Party and returned as secretary of war and navy on 3 March, leaving the post on 16 May. He held the post again from 16 October 1931 to 31 July 1932, and in 1933 served as finance secretary in Rodríguez's cabinet. Between 1929 and 1934, as the 'Jefe Máximo de la Revolución', he kept a decisive influence over national politics.

body.zh-Hant: 1936年4月，卡列斯因抵制卡德納斯而被驅逐出境，此後留在加州，直到1941年阿維拉·卡馬喬總統准許他返國。他於1945年10月19日去世。
body.en: In April 1936 Calles resisted Cárdenas and was deported; he remained in California until President Ávila Camacho permitted his return in 1941. He died on 19 October 1945.

body.zh-Hant: 卡德隆·瓜迪亞1900年3月10日生於聖荷西，出身天主教的中產家庭。他前往比利時學醫，先入魯汶天主教大學，後轉布魯塞爾自由大學，1927年取得外科醫師資格，同年返回哥斯大黎加。他在比利時受到基督教社會主義思想影響，回國後行醫並服務貧民。
body.en: Calderón Guardia was born in San José on 10 March 1900 to a bourgeois, Catholic family. He went to Belgium to study medicine, first at the Catholic University of Louvain and then at the Free University of Brussels, graduating as a surgeon in 1927 and returning to Costa Rica the same year. In Belgium he was influenced by Christian-socialist ideas, and at home he practised medicine among the poor.

body.zh-Hant: 1930年12月他獲任比利時駐哥斯大黎加領事，任至1932年3月。他的政治生涯始於聖荷西中央區市議員（1930至1934年），曾任市議會主席。1934年起他擔任國會議員，其中1937年出任國會議長，據國家博物館頁面；百科條目則說他在1938年被選為議長。1936至1940年他擔任總統指定人（副總統）。
body.en: In December 1930 he was accredited as Belgian consul in Costa Rica, a post he held until March 1932. His political career began as municipal councillor of the central canton of San José (1930–1934), and he became president of the council. He sat in Congress from 1934 and was its president in 1937 according to the National Museum, while the encyclopedia says he was chosen president in 1938. From 1936 to 1940 he was a designado to the presidency (vice-president).

body.zh-Hant: 1939年他代表國家共和黨參選總統，1940年當選，任期自1940至1944年。他推動一連串社會改革，1943年憲法增訂社會保障專章並頒布勞動法典。為推動改革，他的政府與天主教會及共產黨結盟。
body.en: In 1939 he was the National Republican Party's presidential candidate and was elected, serving from 1940 to 1944. He pursued a series of social reforms: in 1943 a chapter of social guarantees was added to the Constitution and the Labor Code was enacted. To carry out the reforms his government allied with the Catholic Church and the Communist Party.

body.zh-Hant: 1944至1946年他住在紐約。1948年他再度參選總統，國會在3月1日宣告選舉無效，內戰隨之爆發，他流亡尼加拉瓜，並於同年12月入侵哥斯大黎加而失敗。1955年他再度發動入侵，同樣失敗。1958年他回國當選國會議員，1962年再度競選總統而落敗。
body.en: From 1944 to 1946 he lived in New York. In 1948 he ran for president again; on 1 March Congress annulled the election and a civil war followed, after which he went into exile in Nicaragua and invaded Costa Rica in December, without success. He launched a second invasion in 1955, which also failed. In 1958 he returned as an elected deputy, and in 1962 he ran for president again and lost.

body.zh-Hant: 1966至1969年間他出任哥斯大黎加駐墨西哥大使，百科條目則寫為1966至1970年。他於1970年6月9日在聖荷西去世，1974年4月17日被宣布為祖國功勳（Benemérito de la Patria），歷史記憶中稱他為「哥斯大黎加的社會改革者」。
body.en: He served as Costa Rican ambassador to Mexico from 1966 to 1969, although the encyclopedia dates this to 1966–1970. He died in San José on 9 June 1970, and on 17 April 1974 he was declared Benemérito de la Patria, remembered as Costa Rica's social reformer.

body.zh-Hant: 文塞斯勞·布拉斯1868年2月26日生於米納斯吉拉斯的聖卡埃塔諾達瓦爾然格蘭德（今布拉索波利斯），是科羅內爾弗朗西斯科·布拉斯·佩雷拉·戈梅斯之子。他1890年畢業於聖保羅法學院，回米納斯後任檢察官、市政長官，1892年當選州議員。1898年出任州內政廳長，至1902年；1903年起任聯邦眾議員，連任至1908年，並成為米納斯議員團領袖。
body.en: Wenceslau Brás was born on 26 February 1868 in São Caetano da Vargem Grande (today Brasópolis), Minas Gerais, son of Colonel Francisco Brás Pereira Gomes. He graduated from the São Paulo Law School in 1890, served in Minas as public prosecutor and municipal intendant, and was elected a state deputy in 1892. He became state secretary of the interior in 1898, until 1902, and from 1903 he was a federal deputy, re-elected until 1908, and leader of the Minas caucus.

heading.zh-Hant: 州長、副總統與當選總統

body.zh-Hant: 1909年4月，他接替去世的若昂·平赫伊魯·達席爾瓦出任米納斯州長。1910年3月，他當選共和國副總統，搭配赫爾梅斯·達豐塞卡元帥，同年9月卸下州長職務。其後米納斯與聖保羅兩州政府推出他為候選人，1914年3月選舉中他擊敗魯伊·巴爾博薩。
body.en: In April 1909 he took over the government of Minas Gerais after the death of João Pinheiro da Silva. In March 1910 he was elected vice-president of the Republic on the ticket headed by Marshal Hermes da Fonseca, and left the state government in September that year. He was then launched as a candidate by the Minas and São Paulo governments, and in the elections of March 1914 he defeated Rui Barbosa.

body.zh-Hant: 1914年11月15日，布拉斯就任聯邦總統，當時第一次世界大戰剛爆發。1916年他處理巴拉那與聖卡塔琳娜的邊界爭議（孔特斯塔多地區）。1917年1月1日他頒布新民法典，同年10月取得國會批准對德宣戰。1918年11月15日羅德里格斯·阿爾維斯就職，他退出公職。
body.en: Brás took office as federal president on 15 November 1914, shortly after the outbreak of the First World War. In 1916 he resolved the boundary question between Paraná and Santa Catarina in the Contestado region. On 1 January 1917 he promulgated the new Civil Code, and in October of that year he obtained Congressional approval to declare war on Germany. With Rodrigues Alves's inauguration on 15 November 1918 he withdrew from public life.

heading.en: Return to politics and party activity

body.zh-Hant: 1924年7月聖保羅叛亂時，叛軍將領伊西多羅·迪亞斯·洛佩斯提議由他加入臨時軍政委員會。1929年10月他赴貝洛奧里藏特參與米納斯共和黨（PRM）執委會討論繼任人選，1931年2月獲選進入米納斯軍團（Legião Mineira）最高評議會。1932年2月「米納斯協議」促成社會民族黨（PSN）成立，他是其領導委員會成員，該黨1932年5月解散。
body.en: During the São Paulo revolt of July 1924 the rebel general Isidoro Dias Lopes proposed his name for a provisional junta. In October 1929 he travelled to Belo Horizonte to join the Mineiro Republican Party (PRM) executive commission's talks on the succession, and in February 1931 he was elected to the supreme council of the Legião Mineira. The 'Acordo mineiro' of February 1932 led to the founding of the Partido Social Nacionalista (PSN), on whose directing commission he sat; the party was dissolved in May 1932.

body.zh-Hant: 1934年7月，他的名字曾被提議作為對抗瓦加斯的總統候選人。1943年他以已遠離公共生活為由拒絕簽署《米納斯人宣言》，1947年起完全退出公職。他曾創辦並主持南米納斯工業公司，1966年5月15日在伊塔茹巴去世。
body.en: In July 1934 his name was floated as a possible presidential candidate against Vargas. In 1943, citing his withdrawal from public life, he refused to sign the Manifesto of the Mineiros, and from 1947 he left public life definitively. He founded and presided over the Companhia Industrial Sul Mineira, and died in Itajubá on 15 May 1966.
